title: Sharplink yield
description: A three-column blueprint section with dotted column guides: a big title whose letters assemble as you scroll and a short paragraph on the left, a tall dark stats card in the middle (black fading to blue, two figures that rise into place, a chart slot and a tinted button), and three faint numbered feature cards on the right that slide in from the right one after another.
notes: transparent background: on the page it shows the Sharplink backdrop wash
the stats card always uses the theme's dark colours (.dark)
chart and feature art are slots; empty, they show faint placeholders
all reveals are CSS view timelines; without support or with reduced motion everything is in place
name: sharplink-yield
